title: Thorn Blade
summary: A +1 scimitar with Poison damage while concentrating and an Ensnaring Strike cast.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 1 Slashing plus Dexterity or Strength. +1 to attack. Martial, one-handed, light, finesse, 5 ft melee.
fields.Poisonous Synergy: While concentrating, add 1d4 Poison to melee weapon attacks. Outside Honour, dual copies can add 2d4. In Honour only hits with that Thorn Blade gain the bonus.
fields.Ensnaring Strike: Level 1, once per Long Rest. Action melee weapon attack with Bonus Action cost on hit. Requires Concentration for up to 10 turns. A Strength save against your spell save DC prevents the vines. Ensnared stops movement, adds 1d6 Piercing per turn, gives disadvantage on attacks and Dexterity saves and grants advantage to attackers. Help removes it.
fields.Flourish: Bonus Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Melee attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save prevents Off Balance for 2 turns. The pinned action lists weapon-action DC for its save and weapon-action DC +2 for its applied condition.
fields.Lacerate: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 avoids Bleeding for 2 turns. At turn start Bleeding deals 2 Slashing, gives Disadvantage on Constitution saves and ends when healed. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.
fields.Acquisition: Dammon’s stock can offer another copy after a reset.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
